messages.content: For user_id u_12345, please check whether there are any .pdf files in /projects/report, then scan the devices in the living_room and identify the smart lock from the results. After that, check the current status of the living room light with device_id light_living and light_id light_living, and based on that set its brightness to 70. Then schedule a high-priority meeting called “Quarterly Planning Sync” with alice@company.com and bob@company.com from 2026-02-14 10:00 to 2026-02-14 11:00, with the description “Discuss roadmap, room readiness, and workspace setup.” After the reminder is created, send Alex a high-priority email saying it was created successfully, then create a document titled “Workspace Preparation Summary” with that same reminder message and the tags office, meeting, and workspace, and send the alert by email.
